brief: An aluminium cantilever bracket: a 60 mm long, 20 mm wide, 6 mm thick bar fixed at one end by two 5 mm bolt holes 15 mm apart near that end. A load of 150 N pushes straight down on the free end. It must have a safety factor of at least 2.

intent.summary: An aluminium cantilever bracket with a 60 mm long, 20 mm wide, and 6 mm thick bar. It is fixed at one end by two 5 mm bolt holes 15 mm apart near that end. A load of 150 N is applied straight down on the free end, and it must have a safety factor of at least 2.
implied: the free end of the bracket
the bolt holes are near the end
the load is applied straight down
unstated: the magnitude and direction of the load on the arm
the material grade of the bracket
the operating temperature of the bracket
the dimensions that are load-bearing for the design's function
risk_signals: part of a vehicle or of regulated equipment

requirements.statement: The length of the cantilever bracket shall be 60 mm.
The width of the cantilever bracket shall be 20 mm.
The thickness of the cantilever bracket shall be 6 mm.
There shall be two bolt holes near the end of the cantilever bracket.
The bearing stress at the bolt holes shall keep a safety factor of at least 2 against yield.
The part shall have 2 open holes of 5 mm.
requirements.rationale: The brief sizes and counts these holes.

assumptions.statement: The 150 N load acts straight down on the free end of the cantilever bracket.

notes: `feature_count:bolt_hole:near_end` names no feature kind, so it was read as `feature_count:hole:bolt`.

REQ_NEAR_END_BOLT_HOLE_COUNT counted `bolt` 2.0 as a bound; the brief states the count -- "an aluminium cantilever bracket: a 60 mm long, 20 mm wide, 6 mm thick bar fixed at one end by two 5 mm bolt holes 15 mm apart near that end" -- so it is exactly that many.

added REQ_HOLES_5MM: the brief states 2 open holes of 5 mm, counted on the built part by diameter. A claim bound to a hole's parameter passes whenever some hole reads that parameter -- a collar had both set screws drawn at the bore's 12 mm, and no bore, and it passed.
